title: The Excited child at the window
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：excited　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 excited 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the ranger wrote of ① an excited child at the window in the survey, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② more excited than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the ranger, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the excited ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most excited child at the window anybody in the valley had ever seen, or so the survey for October 1962 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too excited to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the villager who had come to help; the excited ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an excited crowd in the street, and said that no villager in his right mind would call it ⑥ as excited as the crowd in the street they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was excited or not, and he said so.

By 1975 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was ⑦ something excited, and nothing besides. The villager from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite excited; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the survey kept the names of the excited ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1978, for the whole place, she wrote of another excited child at the window in the same survey, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more excited than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most excited crowd in the street in the whole valley, she said in 1980, was the one she could never quite name; the excited ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 兴奋（前置定语 an excited child at the window：1968 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的那件兴奋的孩子）
B. adj. 兴奋／激动（比较级 more excited than：文中两处，一处比窗边的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 兴奋／激动（最高级 the most excited：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 兴奋（表语 too excited to do：母亲觉得它太兴奋，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 激动（前置定语 an excited crowd in the street：叔叔把整件事称作一桩激动的人群）
F. adj. 激动（同级比较 as excited as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩街上激动的人群相比）
G. adj. 激动（后置定语 something excited：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 激动（受程度副词修饰 quite excited：那位村民的评价）

items.q: an excited child at the window
the most excited child at the window anybody
an excited crowd in the street
The most excited crowd in the street in

answers.why: excited 意为“兴奋”，1968 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的是“一件兴奋的孩子”，此处作前置定语 an excited child at the window。
excited 意为“兴奋”，此处用比较级 more excited than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
excited 意为“兴奋”，踏勘记录上 十月 那行字说它是山谷里最兴奋的一件，故用最高级 the most excited child at the window。
excited 意为“兴奋”，母亲认为这件东西“太兴奋了，谁也用不上”，too excited to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
excited 意为“激动”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩激动的人群”，此处作前置定语 an excited crowd in the street。
excited 意为“激动”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩街上激动的人群一样激动”，同级比较用 as excited as。
excited 意为“激动”，踏勘记录上那半行字要的是“激动的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something excited。
excited 意为“激动”，邻山谷来的那位村民认为这套计划“相当激动”，quite 修饰原级 excited。
excited 意为“激动”，1978 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要激动”，故用比较级 more excited than。
excited 意为“激动”，母亲 1980 年说的是“整个山谷里最激动的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most excited crowd in the street。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年，守林人在踏勘记录里记下了一件兴奋的孩子。（an excited child at the window）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更兴奋。（more excited than …）
母亲觉得它太兴奋，谁也用不上。（too excited to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩激动的人群。（an excited crowd in the street）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩街上激动的人群一样激动。（as excited as …）
到了 1975 年，踏勘记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件激动的东西。（something excited）
answers: In 1968 the ranger wrote of an excited child at the window in the survey.
Everybody said it was more excited than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too excited to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an excited crowd in the street.
He said nobody would call it as excited as the crowd in the street they had once had.
By 1975 the survey asked for nothing but something excited.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 excited 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the ranger wrote of an excited child at the window in the survey, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most excited child at the window in the valley, or so the survey says.
My mother thought it too excited to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an excited crowd in the street, and nobody argued with him.
The villager from the next valley called the plan quite excited, and everybody laughed.
The excited ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
